# MI Controls Jobs

> MI Controls Jobs (micontrolsjobs.com) is a Michigan-only job board for PLC,
> controls, and automation roles — controls technicians, PLC programmers,
> automation technicians, and controls engineers. Tagline: "Controls jobs, only
> controls candidates." It lists only Michigan openings in this one trade.

## The business

- Operated by MS ECOM LLC, 2327 Somerset Blvd, Troy, MI 48084.
- Contact: mitchell@msecomllc.com
- Free for job seekers, always. A weekly email roundup of new Michigan
  controls openings is free to subscribe to.
- Listings are real openings indexed from employer postings. Each listing
  links to the employer's own posting, where candidates apply. Employers can
  claim their listing free to verify it and route applications to their email.

## For employers — posting prices (30 days each, no auto-renewal)

- Standard post: $149
- Featured post: $249
- Premium post: $450
- Second-location add-on: $49
- Free-repost guarantee: fewer than 3 qualified applicants in 30 days earns a
  free 30-day repost, auto-upgraded to Featured. A qualified applicant applies
  through the post and matches the role's trade, city area, and shift.

## Key pages

- Home / all listings: https://micontrolsjobs.com/
- Post a job (prices, FAQ, intake form): https://micontrolsjobs.com/post-a-job.html
- Michigan Controls Hiring Snapshot (live counts of openings, employers,
  cities, and posted pay, computed from the board's own listings):
  https://micontrolsjobs.com/snapshot.html
- Claim a listing (employers): https://micontrolsjobs.com/claim.html
- Referral program terms: https://micontrolsjobs.com/referral-terms.html
- Privacy policy: https://micontrolsjobs.com/privacy.html
- Job feed (XML, for aggregators): https://micontrolsjobs.com/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://micontrolsjobs.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI systems

- Every job has its own page under https://micontrolsjobs.com/jobs/job-<id>.html
  with JobPosting structured data (title, employer, Michigan city, date
  posted, pay where the employer states it).
- The board covers Michigan only and this single trade only; it does not list
  jobs outside Michigan or outside PLC/controls/automation.
